quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #4
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 35

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: You have a green light and pedestrians are in the intersection. What should you do?

options.text: You must let pedestrians cross first.
You have the right-of-way over pedestrians.
Pedestrians must wait for you to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must let pedestrians cross first.
questions.explanation: Even with a green light, you must yield to pedestrians already in the intersection. Drivers must wait for pedestrians to cross when turning on a steady green signal.

questions.question: What does this red and white sign mean?

options.text: Stop and check both directions before proceeding.
Let traffic on the road ahead go first.
Keep going and check all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let traffic on the road ahead go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and be ready to stop. Let all vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass before you go. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What is the only thing that lowers blood alcohol level?
questions.explanation: Only time allows your body to break down alcohol. Eating, drinking coffee, or other actions cannot speed this up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a right turn with a line through it. It means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What word appears on a red octagon-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: An octagon (eight-sided) sign always says "stop." You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: Which is NOT safe on the interstate?

options.text: Go to the next exit if you miss yours.

questions.explanation: Always signal before changing lanes. Slower traffic should stay in the right lane. If you miss your exit, go to the next one. Never back up or make a U-turn on an interstate.

questions.question: When following which vehicle should you allow extra space?
questions.explanation: Keep extra distance behind motorcycles. They can stop faster than cars and are hard to see. Give them space in case they stop suddenly or fall.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction the arrow points.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction the arrow points.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you which direction to drive. You must follow the arrow's direction. This is a traffic law you must obey.

questions.question: What does this road sign warn you about?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns of a steep hill coming. Slow down to avoid crashes and brake damage.

questions.question: On roadways, bicycles are considered:
questions.explanation: Bicycles are vehicles on roadways. Cyclists and drivers must follow the same traffic rules.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: If you see pedestrians in a crosswalk ahead, what should you do?

options.text: Continue ahead. You have the right-of-way.
Wait for the pedestrians to cross the street.
Pull to the right and go around the pedestrians.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for the pedestrians to cross the street.
questions.explanation: You must let pedestrians cross at a crosswalk. Wait until the intersection is clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left then right.
The road curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that the road will curve right, then curve left. Slow down to safely handle the curves.

questions.question: What is the maximum speed limit on a rural interstate highway?
questions.explanation: The maximum speed on a rural interstate is 70 miles per hour. Follow this limit unless a different speed is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs tell you a school zone is nearby or ahead. Watch for children and obey posted speed limits in school zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided roadway is ending. Traffic is now moving in both directions.

questions.question: What does a sign with this shape mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks where a no passing zone begins.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means you must stop.

questions.question: You see a flashing red light at an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Slow down and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Come to a complete stop, check traffic, and go when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, check traffic, and go when safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. You must stop completely, check for traffic and pedestrians, and then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn left only after you stop.
All drivers must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means no left turns.

questions.question: When is it safe to move back into your lane after passing a vehicle?

options.text: When the driver you passed signals you to return.
When you signal for three seconds.
When you can see the passed vehicle's headlights in your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you can see the passed vehicle's headlights in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Check your rearview mirror before returning to your lane. When you see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your mirror, you have enough space to move back safely.

questions.question: You see pedestrians near the road. What should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn and keep going.
Speed up to get past them quickly.
Slow down and drive carefully past them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and drive carefully past them.
questions.explanation: When you see pedestrians near the road, slow down and be ready to stop. They may cross your path unexpectedly.

questions.question: A person using a white cane or guide dog is crossing the street. What should you do?

options.text: Stop until the person is far away from your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop until the person is far away from your vehicle.
questions.explanation: You must stop for people using white canes or guide dogs. They are blind and have the right-of-way. Wait until they have crossed completely.

questions.question: Before you enter a curve, you should:
questions.explanation: Slow down before entering a curve. Going too fast through a curve is dangerous. You can drive slower than the speed limit when conditions require it, but never faster.

questions.question: Which statement about blind spots is true?

options.text: Mirrors on both sides eliminate all blind spots.
Large trucks have bigger blind spots than most cars.
You can see all blind spots using your rearview mirrors.

questions.correctAnswerText: Large trucks have bigger blind spots than most cars.
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas you cannot see in your mirrors. Large trucks have much larger blind spots than regular cars. Other drivers should avoid these areas.

questions.question: You see animals near the road. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to scare them away.

questions.explanation: Slow down when you see animals near the road. They may run or jump into traffic without warning. There may be more animals you cannot see.

questions.question: What does this yellow pennant-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow pennant-shaped signs mark areas where you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: At dawn, dusk, rain, or snow, it is hard to see and be seen. How can you let other drivers know you are there?
questions.explanation: Use your headlights when you cannot see clearly or when other drivers may have trouble seeing you. Turn on your headlights whenever you use your windshield wipers.

questions.question: Hydroplaning happens when your tires ride on water instead of the road. How can you prevent it in rain?

options.text: Use cruise control to keep a steady speed.
Move to the shoulder as soon as it rains.

questions.explanation: Slow down in rain to avoid hydroplaning. Driving too fast in wet weather causes your tires to float on water and lose grip on the road, making your vehicle hard to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up.

questions.question: What does an orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle always mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: You are on the freeway and traffic is merging into your lane. What should you do?

options.text: Make room for the merging traffic, if possible.
Speed up to protect your right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make room for the merging traffic, if possible.
questions.explanation: When you can, make room to let vehicles merge into your lane safely.

questions.question: When is it safe to move back into the right lane after passing a vehicle on the left?

options.text: When you can no longer see the vehicle over your right shoulder.
When you can see the front of the vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you can see the front of the vehicle in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: When passing another vehicle, move back into the right lane only when you can see the passed vehicle's headlights in your rearview mirror. Always signal before changing lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What skills do drivers need for interstate driving?

options.text: The ability to safely drive at high speeds.

questions.explanation: Safe interstate driving requires you to stay alert at all times and be able to drive safely at high speeds.

questions.question: At an intersection with stop signs on all corners, who has the right-of-way?
questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, vehicles go through in the order they arrived. If multiple vehicles arrive at the same time, the one on the right goes first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers of a school zone or school crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that making a U-turn is not allowed in this location.
